figures.caption: The sixteen-output impulse call returns before its result words are stored.
figures.alt: Six annotated panels at filter_ready show returns sixteen and zero. Seven zero history samples precede an impulse of 16000. Eight coefficient codes of 4096 produce eight output codes of 2000 followed by zeros. Caller processed and clipped remain 99, while all input and coefficient bytes are unchanged.

figures.caption: The completed impulse response has eight nonzero outputs and saved counts sixteen and zero.
figures.alt: Four annotated panels at results_ready show current returns sixteen and zero, all sixteen impulse output halfwords and saved processed/clipped words sixteen and zero. The first eight outputs are 2000 and the remaining eight are zero. Output is a distinct slice from input and coefficients; exit has not executed.

figures.caption: A negative halfway value rounds to the minimum halfword without clipping.
figures.alt: Six annotated panels at filter_ready show one output and zero clipped. The first inputs are minus 32768 and three; the first coefficients are 32767 and minus 16384, with all remaining codes zero. Their exact scaled sum is minus 32768.5, which rounds toward positive infinity at the tie to minus 32768. Stored output is 00 80 and caller result words remain 99.

figures.caption: Changing one input code produces the same endpoint with one clipping event.
figures.alt: Six annotated panels at filter_ready show one output and one clipped. The second input is four instead of three, with unchanged coefficients 32767 and minus 16384. The exact accumulator is minus 1073774592 and its rounded value is minus 32769, so saturation stores minus 32768. The output bytes still match the un-clipped tie case, but v1 is one.

figures.caption: Eight exact products require an accumulator beyond 32-bit range before rounding.
figures.alt: Eight annotated details inside the guided MSA kernel at fir_round. Initialized counters are one and zero. Scalar t0 is 8589934592 and the two 64-bit w7 integer lanes are each 4294967296. All eight inputs and coefficients are minus 32768, producing eight products of 1073741824. No output has been stored and both caller result words remain 99.
